title: Baingan Bharta
description: Whole eggplant roasted over an open flame until smoky and soft, then mashed and cooked with onion, tomato and spices — a distinctive smoky sabzi.
steps: Rub the whole eggplant lightly with oil and roast directly over a gas flame (or under a hot grill), turning occasionally, until the skin is charred all over and the flesh is completely soft, about 12-15 minutes.
Let it cool slightly, then peel off the charred skin and mash the flesh roughly with a fork. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle, then add the onion and sauté until golden brown.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and green chillies, cook for a minute, then add the tomatoes and cook until soft, about 6-8 minutes.
Stir in the turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and salt, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the mashed eggplant and mix well, cooking for 8-10 minutes so the flavours combine. Garnish with coriander leaves before serving.
